title: Before your first ride
note: One screen, one list, one button. Each row says why in five words.

title: Now
note: Your likely route is already picked. Start is the only button.

title: Riding
note: Full-bleed map, one sheet: where, how long, and that the alarm is set.

title: Riding at night
note: True black at night: easy on the eyes on a dark bus.

title: GPS lost
note: The only change is one red line that says what still happens.

title: Ringing
note: Like the phone's own alarm: black, one big line, one control. Messages wait until you're awake.

title: After I'm awake
note: What to do first, then what you missed. Nothing else.

title: Transfer
note: Same screen as riding: the stop changes, the line says you're waiting.

title: Routes
note: Two rows. A problem is a red line on the row, nothing more.

title: From work
note: The route as stops on a line. The button is the next thing it needs.

title: Set a stop
note: The map does the work. Pick a distance, save.

title: Settings
note: Five rows. Everything technical is gone.

title: Lock screen
note: What you see while dozing: one line and a bar.
